name: Postoperative Surface Alignment
definition: An optimization strategy to deform an initial height-field model G0 to match postoperative MRI depth data while retaining initial cortical texture, using depth loss, transition objective, and tracked self-supervision.
summary: Postoperative Surface Alignment deforms a Gaussian model to match MRI depth while preserving texture, distinguishing itself by using alternating optimization to prevent surface tearing and appearance instability.
